text: The article stipulates a broad definition of digital assets covering all virtual and electronic assets regardless of how regulators name or categorize them, including cryptocurrencies, security tokens, utility tokens, virtual collectibles, stablecoins, and altcoins.
citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
